name: Riparian vegetation cover (trees, bushes, herbaceous)
source: Idea and 1-5 scale: OneAquaHealth Field Sampling Protocols (Zenodo 20344421), section 3.5 and Annex I riparian cover categories (1 = 0-20% ... 5 = 81-100%); D2.4 p.22 places riparian vegetation as the slowest responder. delta: Firstline declared parameter (1 class unit); not a D2.4 number.

name: Bank stability (visible bank erosion)
source: Idea: D2.4 p.26 lists bank stability among the routine ecological and hydraulic checks (vegetation cover, channel morphology, bank stability); D2.4 p.30 names bank erosion under geomorphological changes. The 1-5 lay scoring is Firstline's. delta: Firstline declared parameter (1 class unit); not a D2.4 number.

name: Litter and floating debris
source: Idea: D2.4 section 4.2.3 (p.43) on litter, plastic and hydrocarbon pollution; D2.4 p.27 lists removal of urban solid waste. Not a parameter of the OAH field form (Zenodo 20344421) or the Key Indicators factsheets (Zenodo 20345207); the 1-5 lay scoring is Firstline's. delta: Firstline declared parameter (1 class unit); not a D2.4 number.

name: Odour at the water
source: Firstline lay proxy for D2.4 p.30 water pollution (organic matter, nutrients). Odour is not a parameter of D2.4, the OAH field form (Zenodo 20344421) or the Key Indicators factsheets (Zenodo 20345207); it is the least-grounded indicator here. delta: Firstline declared parameter (1 class unit); not a D2.4 number.

name: Water clarity and colour
source: Firstline lay proxy for D2.4 p.30 water pollution (suspended solids). Clarity is not a parameter of the OAH field form (Zenodo 20344421); the field form records dissolved solids by probe, which a citizen cannot do. delta: Firstline declared parameter (1 class unit); not a D2.4 number.

name: Visible algae in the channel
source: Idea: OAH Field Sampling Protocols (Zenodo 20344421) Annex I lists filamentous algae as a channel vegetation type recorded as absent, present or extensive; D2.4 p.22 says algae often respond rapidly. The 1-5 scoring is Firstline's. delta: Firstline declared parameter (1 class unit); not a D2.4 number.

name: Flow and dry channel
source: Idea: OAH Field Sampling Protocols (Zenodo 20344421) Annex I flow types, including 'D: Dry areas/Intermittent flow'; D2.4 p.30 names flashiness and reduced baseflow under altered hydrology. The 1-5 scoring is Firstline's. delta: Firstline declared parameter (1 class unit); not a D2.4 number.

name: Barrier passability (visible weirs, culverts, drops)
source: Idea: OAH Field Sampling Protocols (Zenodo 20344421) Annex I 'Barriers to longitudinal connectivity (number of weirs/dams)'; D2.4 p.30 lists culverts, weirs, grids, bridges and dams as barriers. The form counts barriers; the 1-5 passability score is Firstline's. delta: Firstline declared parameter (1 class unit); not a D2.4 number.
